description: Pause a People Search task and return its updated status. Free: it charges and refunds nothing. A queued search pauses at once; a running one finishes its current batch first (status pausing, then paused). Pausing loses no data: the people found so far stay readable with people-search-status, and the search keeps its progress. Billing does not change: the reservation made when the search started stays reserved while paused and is settled only when the search ends. Undo it with people-search-resume, which continues from where the search stopped with no new charge. Limit: a search paused for more than 7 days is cancelled by the API and can no longer be resumed; you then pay only for the people already delivered, the rest of the reservation is returned, and the people found stay readable for 30 days.
name: people-search-pause
title: Pause People Search
